annotations.title: Draft the reply to App Review's message

description: Keeps the developer's reply to App Review's message after an App Store rejection, for when the message waits for an answer (it asks for information or a question, like Guideline 2.1 Information Needed; ploa_app_review_status and ploa_review_rejection say so) or the person disagrees with it. A rejection that asks for a fix needs no reply: the fixed build or store page is the answer, and ploa_release_submit_review sends it back without any text. The reply is sent before the version goes back to App Review: once it does, App Store Connect closes the thread (no reply box), and Ploa then refuses a new draft and closes one not sent. The person sends it in one step: it shows on the app's Release page under the version, with Copy reply, a link to that submission's thread in App Store Connect › App Review, and I sent it. Apple's API has no way to send a message in App Review's thread, so Ploa never sends it there and nothing reaches Apple from this tool: the person pastes it and presses Send in App Store Connect. To have App Review read it with a resubmission too, pass the reply's id as replyId to ploa_release_submit_review: under that approval Ploa puts it in the version's App Review Information › Notes. Write the reply in English, short and factual, answering what App Review asked (what changed in the build, where the reviewer finds it), from ploa_review_rejection's message and the app's code; show it to the person before you keep it. A newer draft for the same version replaces the one not sent yet. With sent and the reply's id, keeps it as sent once the person says they sent it.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

item.description: Or the rejection's key from ploa_review_rejection (apple:version:…).

sent.description: Instead of text: the id of a reply the person sent in App Store Connect, to keep it as sent.

submission.description: The review submission's ID at App Store Connect, when the rejection is no longer in ploa_review_rejection (the version was resubmitted): the link then opens its thread.

text.description: The reply, in English, as it goes to App Review. Up to 4000 characters (what App Review Information › Notes takes).

translations.description: The reply translated, shown beside it to people who read Ploa in that language.

he.description: The reply in Hebrew, for a person who reads Ploa in Hebrew; the English one is what goes to Apple.

version.description: The App Store version it's about, like 1.0.0. Leave out for the newest rejected one.
